original_goal:
[Module: Open New Account | TC-016 | Type: Edge/Boundary | Priority: Medium]
Title: Funding account balance exactly equals deposit amount — boundary succeeds

▶ Start URL:    http://localhost:8080/open-new-account
▶ Requires Auth: Yes
▶ Test Data:
{
  "account_type": "Checking",
  "initial_deposit": "5847.52",
  "funding_account": "****5001 (Checking)",
  "funding_account_balance": "5847.52",
  "user_email": "admin@parabank.com",
  "username": "admin"
}

Preconditions:
  A funding account exists whose balance exactly equals the intended deposit amount (Checking ****5001 has balance $5,847.52). User is logged in as 'admin' (admin@parabank.com).

Steps to Execute:
  1. Select 'Checking' as Account Type (meets Checking minimum of $25)
  2. Enter '5847.52' in Initial Deposit Amount (X)
  3. Select the funding account '****5001 (Checking, $5,847.52)' which has balance = 5847.52
  4. Click 'Open Account'

Expected Result:
  Form submits; "Account opened successfully!" is shown; redirect to Accounts Overview

Notes from prior verification:
  Used the exact seeded Checking account balance (5,847.52) as the deposit amount to exercise the boundary condition. Verification note: existence of exact-balance account is an external data precondition but is satisfied by seed data.
expected_outcome: Form submits; "Account opened successfully!" is shown; redirect to Accounts Overview
